48	def launch_commands(repo: Path, feature: str, run_id: str, run_root: Path, herdr: bool = True, automatic: bool = False,
49	                    worker_timeout_seconds: int | None = None, review_timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
50	                    reviewer_transport: str | None = None, workers: str | None = None) -> tuple[Path, list[list[str]], list[str]]:
51	    """The exact commands a launch runs, the run directory and any deprecation notes; nothing is executed here."""
52	    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}", run_id):
53	        raise ValueError("run-id must be an opaque identifier, not a path")
54	    folder = repo / "features" / feature
55	    manifest, notes = load_feature(folder)
56	    policy_path = feature_file(folder, manifest["policy"])
57	    policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
58	    declared = policy_workers(policy)
59	    if [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]] != declared:
60	        raise ValueError(f"feature.json workers ({', '.join(worker['node_id'] for worker in manifest['workers'])}) must be the policy's lanes in order ({', '.join(declared)})")
61	    tasks = {}
62	    for worker in manifest["workers"]:
63	        path = feature_file(folder, worker["task"])
64	        if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
65	            raise ValueError(f"Task file for lane {worker['node_id']} is missing or empty: {worker['task']}")
66	        tasks[worker["node_id"]] = path
67	    # Unknown ids, duplicates and an empty list are refused here, before any Git action.
68	    selected = parse_lane_selection(workers, declared)
69	    run = (run_root / run_id).resolve()
70	    if run == repo or repo in run.parents:
71	        raise ValueError("Run storage must be outside the repository")
72	    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "workflow"]
73	    preflight = [*base, "preflight", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
74	    start = [*base, "start", str(run), "--live"]
75	    if herdr:
76	        preflight.append("--herdr")
77	        start.append("--herdr")
78	    branch = f"{manifest['branch_prefix']}/{run_id}"
79	    prepare = [*base, "prepare", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
80	    if workers is not None:
81	        prepare.extend(["--workers", ",".join(selected)])
82	    for node in selected:
83	        prepare.extend(["--task", f"{node}={tasks[node]}"])
84	    commands = [preflight, ["git", "switch", "-c", branch], prepare, start]
85	    if automatic:
86	        from .automatic import automatic_settings
87	        # Reject bad deadlines or an unknown transport before any command runs.
88	        settings = automatic_settings(worker_timeout_seconds, review_timeout_seconds, reviewer_transport)
89	        commands[0].append("--automatic")
90	        commands[2].extend(["--automatic", "--worker-timeout-seconds", str(settings["worker_timeout_seconds"]),
91	                            "--review-timeout-seconds", str(settings["review_timeout_seconds"]),
92	                            "--reviewer-transport", settings["reviewer_transport"]])
93	        commands.append([*base, "automatic", str(run), "--live"])
94	    elif worker_timeout_seconds is not None or review_timeout_seconds is not None or reviewer_transport is not None:
95	        raise ValueError("Timeouts and the reviewer transport apply to --automatic runs only")
96	    drill = policy.get("failure_drill")
97	    if drill and drill["node_id"] not in selected:
98	        notes.append(f"Failure drill skipped: its lane {drill['node_id']} is not selected (selected: {', '.join(selected)}).")
99	    return run, commands, notes

102	def main(argv=None):
103	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
104	    parser.add_argument("feature", choices=FEATURES)
105	    parser.add_argument("--run-id", help="Opaque run identifier (default: <feature>-001)")
106	    parser.add_argument("--run-root", type=Path, help="Run storage outside the repository (default: ~/.local/state/md-manager-workflows/<feature>)")
107	    parser.add_argument("--workers", help="Comma-separated subset of the feature's declared lanes to launch (default: every declared lane)")
108	    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="Authorize Claude usage")
109	    parser.add_argument("--automatic", action="store_true", help="Bypass worker permission prompts; run through independent review to a verified feature branch")
110	    parser.add_argument("--worker-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: per-worker deadline from launch to completion signal (default 4h, max 24h)")
111	    parser.add_argument("--review-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: reviewer deadline from its launch to its completion file (default 30m, max 24h)")
112	    parser.add_argument("--reviewer-transport", choices=["native", "print"], help="Automatic mode: native attachable reviewer session (default) or headless claude --print")
113	    parser.add_argument("--no-herdr", action="store_true", help="Explicitly omit terminal attachments")
114	    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate feature configuration and print commands only")
115	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
116	    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
117	    run_id = args.run_id or f"{args.feature}-001"
118	    run_root = args.run_root or Path.home() / ".local/state/md-manager-workflows" / args.feature

121	                                               args.worker_timeout_seconds, args.review_timeout_seconds, args.reviewer_transport, args.workers)
122	        prepare = commands[2]
123	        selected = [prepare[index + 1].split("=", 1)[0] for index, item in enumerate(prepare) if item == "--task"]
124	        if args.dry_run:
125	            print(json.dumps({"run_directory": str(run), "workers": selected, "commands": commands, "executes": False, "notes": notes}, indent=2))

133	        for note in notes:

147	        drill_note = next((note for note in notes if note.startswith("Failure drill skipped")), None)

"""One-command preparation/start of a committed feature; never skips human gates."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .pipeline import parse_lane_selection, policy_workers, validate_pipeline_policy
from .sessions import read_json, validate_node_id
from .verification import validate_schema


FEATURES = ("project-workflows", "worker-lanes", "parallel-reviewers")
FEATURE_VERSION = "2.0.0"
DEPRECATED_FEATURE_NOTE = ("feature.json version 1.0.0 (ui_task/adapter_task) is deprecated: it is translated to 2.0.0 "
                           "(workers: [{node_id, task}]); migrate the file. See contracts/workflow/feature.schema.json.")


def load_feature(folder: Path) -> tuple[dict, list[str]]:
    """The feature file as 2.0.0 plus any deprecation notes; 1.0.0 files are translated in memory."""
    manifest = read_json(folder / "feature.json")
    notes = []
    if isinstance(manifest, dict) and manifest.get("version") == "1.0.0":
        translated = {key: manifest[key] for key in ("name", "branch_prefix", "policy") if key in manifest}
        translated["version"] = FEATURE_VERSION
        translated["workers"] = [{"node_id": "ui", "task": manifest.get("ui_task")}, {"node_id": "adapter", "task": manifest.get("adapter_task")}]
        manifest = translated
        notes.append(DEPRECATED_FEATURE_NOTE)
    validate_schema("feature", manifest)
    ids = [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]]
    if len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
        raise ValueError("feature.json declares a worker lane twice")
    for node in ids:
        validate_node_id(node)
    return manifest, notes


def feature_file(folder: Path, name: str) -> Path:
    path = (folder / name).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Feature file escapes feature directory")
    return path


def launch_commands(repo: Path, feature: str, run_id: str, run_root: Path, herdr: bool = True, automatic: bool = False,
                    worker_timeout_seconds: int | None = None, review_timeout_seconds: int | None = None,
                    reviewer_transport: str | None = None, workers: str | None = None) -> tuple[Path, list[list[str]], list[str]]:
    """The exact commands a launch runs, the run directory and any deprecation notes; nothing is executed here."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}", run_id):
        raise ValueError("run-id must be an opaque identifier, not a path")
    folder = repo / "features" / feature
    manifest, notes = load_feature(folder)
    policy_path = feature_file(folder, manifest["policy"])
    policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
    declared = policy_workers(policy)
    if [worker["node_id"] for worker in manifest["workers"]] != declared:
        raise ValueError(f"feature.json workers ({', '.join(worker['node_id'] for worker in manifest['workers'])}) must be the policy's lanes in order ({', '.join(declared)})")
    tasks = {}
    for worker in manifest["workers"]:
        path = feature_file(folder, worker["task"])
        if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
            raise ValueError(f"Task file for lane {worker['node_id']} is missing or empty: {worker['task']}")
        tasks[worker["node_id"]] = path
    # Unknown ids, duplicates and an empty list are refused here, before any Git action.
    selected = parse_lane_selection(workers, declared)
    run = (run_root / run_id).resolve()
    if run == repo or repo in run.parents:
        raise ValueError("Run storage must be outside the repository")
    base = [sys.executable, "-m", "workflow"]
    preflight = [*base, "preflight", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
    start = [*base, "start", str(run), "--live"]
    if herdr:
        preflight.append("--herdr")
        start.append("--herdr")
    branch = f"{manifest['branch_prefix']}/{run_id}"
    prepare = [*base, "prepare", str(run), "--repo", str(repo), "--policy", str(policy_path)]
    if workers is not None:
        prepare.extend(["--workers", ",".join(selected)])
    for node in selected:
        prepare.extend(["--task", f"{node}={tasks[node]}"])
    commands = [preflight, ["git", "switch", "-c", branch], prepare, start]
    if automatic:
        from .automatic import automatic_settings
        # Reject bad deadlines or an unknown transport before any command runs.
        settings = automatic_settings(worker_timeout_seconds, review_timeout_seconds, reviewer_transport)
        commands[0].append("--automatic")
        commands[2].extend(["--automatic", "--worker-timeout-seconds", str(settings["worker_timeout_seconds"]),
                            "--review-timeout-seconds", str(settings["review_timeout_seconds"]),
                            "--reviewer-transport", settings["reviewer_transport"]])
        commands.append([*base, "automatic", str(run), "--live"])
    elif worker_timeout_seconds is not None or review_timeout_seconds is not None or reviewer_transport is not None:
        raise ValueError("Timeouts and the reviewer transport apply to --automatic runs only")
    drill = policy.get("failure_drill")
    if drill and drill["node_id"] not in selected:
        notes.append(f"Failure drill skipped: its lane {drill['node_id']} is not selected (selected: {', '.join(selected)}).")
    return run, commands, notes


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("feature", choices=FEATURES)
    parser.add_argument("--run-id", help="Opaque run identifier (default: <feature>-001)")
    parser.add_argument("--run-root", type=Path, help="Run storage outside the repository (default: ~/.local/state/md-manager-workflows/<feature>)")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", help="Comma-separated subset of the feature's declared lanes to launch (default: every declared lane)")
    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="Authorize Claude usage")
    parser.add_argument("--automatic", action="store_true", help="Bypass worker permission prompts; run through independent review to a verified feature branch")
    parser.add_argument("--worker-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: per-worker deadline from launch to completion signal (default 4h, max 24h)")
    parser.add_argument("--review-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: reviewer deadline from its launch to its completion file (default 30m, max 24h)")
    parser.add_argument("--reviewer-transport", choices=["native", "print"], help="Automatic mode: native attachable reviewer session (default) or headless claude --print")
    parser.add_argument("--no-herdr", action="store_true", help="Explicitly omit terminal attachments")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Validate feature configuration and print commands only")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    run_id = args.run_id or f"{args.feature}-001"
    run_root = args.run_root or Path.home() / ".local/state/md-manager-workflows" / args.feature
    try:
        run, commands, notes = launch_commands(repo, args.feature, run_id, run_root.resolve(), not args.no_herdr, args.automatic,
                                               args.worker_timeout_seconds, args.review_timeout_seconds, args.reviewer_transport, args.workers)
        prepare = commands[2]
        selected = [prepare[index + 1].split("=", 1)[0] for index, item in enumerate(prepare) if item == "--task"]
        if args.dry_run:
            print(json.dumps({"run_directory": str(run), "workers": selected, "commands": commands, "executes": False, "notes": notes}, indent=2))
            for note in notes:
                print(f"Deprecation: {note}" if note is DEPRECATED_FEATURE_NOTE else f"Note: {note}", file=sys.stderr)
            return
        if not args.live:
            parser.error("Use --live to authorize worker usage, or --dry-run to inspect without running anything")
        if run.exists():
            raise ValueError(f"Run already exists: {run}. Inspect it with status; do not launch duplicate workers.")
        for note in notes:
            print(f"Deprecation: {note}" if note is DEPRECATED_FEATURE_NOTE else f"Note: {note}", file=sys.stderr)
        try:
            for command in commands:
                subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, check=True)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            parser.exit(130, f"Launch interrupted. Nothing was rolled back. If workers were started they are still running;\n"
                             f"inspect with: {sys.executable} -m workflow status {run}\n"
                             + (f"resume with:  {sys.executable} -m workflow automatic {run} --live\n" if args.automatic else ""))
        if args.automatic:
            print(f"\nAutomatic run finished. Evidence: {run / 'report.html'}. No main merge or push.")
            return
        print(f"\nRun: {run}\nWorkers ({', '.join(selected)}) are in their dedicated Herdr tab (unless --no-herdr).")
        print("Watch/answer permission prompts. When every worker finishes, return to Pi for handoffs and freeze.")
        drill_note = next((note for note in notes if note.startswith("Failure drill skipped")), None)
        if drill_note:
            print(drill_note)
        else:
            policy = read_json(feature_file(repo / "features" / args.feature, load_feature(repo / "features" / args.feature)[0]["policy"]))
            drill = policy.get("failure_drill")
            if drill:
                print(f"The intentional {drill['node_id']} verification drill will block its first attempt; retry that check explicitly after restarting the controller.")
        print(f"Status: {sys.executable} -m workflow status {run}")
        print("Review and integration still require separate explicit approval. Nothing is pushed.")
    except (ValueError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        parser.exit(1, f"Launch blocked: {error}\nNo fallback, reset or cleanup was attempted. Inspect any retained branch/run state.\n")
    except Exception as error:  # jsonschema ValidationError on the feature file
        from jsonschema.exceptions import ValidationError
        if not isinstance(error, ValidationError):
            raise
        parser.exit(1, f"Launch blocked: feature.json is invalid: {error.message}\nNo fallback, reset or cleanup was attempted.\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

1	"""Atomic read-only-consumer export. Producing state never launches an agent.
2	
3	Version 1.2.0 adds two sections derived from the run's own files: `review`
4	(the persisted verdict) and `inputs` (what the run was asked to do). Missing
5	evidence is `null`; a malformed optional receipt is `null` too, never guessed.
6	The reviewer transport of a plan pinned before that setting existed is the one
7	the run's receipts record, or `null` before any reviewer ran; never a default.
8	
9	Version 1.3.0 (additive) takes the worker lanes from the run's plan: the graph
10	definition has one `launch_<lane>` and one `verify_<lane>` node per selected
11	lane, `inputs.workers` is keyed by those lanes in policy order with each lane's
12	`required_check_kinds`, and `inputs` records `selected_workers` and
13	`excluded_workers`. A run exported before keeps its stored definition when it
14	names the same nodes, so re-exporting an old run changes no labels.
15	"""
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	import hashlib
19	import json
20	import shlex
21	from datetime import datetime, timezone
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from .sessions import plan_excluded, plan_workers, read_json, save_json
25	from .verification import required_kinds
26	
27	EXPORT_VERSION = "1.3.0"
28	
29	GRAPH_TAIL = [
30	    {"node_id": "candidate", "label": "Verify combined candidate", "kind": "verification"},
31	    {"node_id": "review", "label": "Independent review", "kind": "review", "depends_on": ["candidate"]},
32	    {"node_id": "approval", "label": "Integration approval", "kind": "integration", "depends_on": ["review"]},
33	    {"node_id": "integrate", "label": "Integrate candidate", "kind": "integration", "depends_on": ["approval"]},
34	]
35	
36	
37	def graph_nodes(workers: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
38	    """The pinned graph of a run over `workers`: per-lane launch and verify fan-outs around the fixed tail."""
39	    launches = [f"launch_{node}" for node in workers]
40	    verifies = [f"verify_{node}" for node in workers]
41	    nodes = [{"node_id": name, "label": f"Launch {node} worker", "kind": "worker", "depends_on": []} for node, name in zip(workers, launches)]
42	    nodes.append({"node_id": "handoff", "label": "Freeze worker handoffs", "kind": "prepare", "depends_on": launches})
43	    nodes.extend({"node_id": name, "label": f"Verify {node}", "kind": "verification", "depends_on": ["handoff"]} for node, name in zip(workers, verifies))
44	    for item in GRAPH_TAIL:
45	        nodes.append({**item, "depends_on": list(item.get("depends_on", verifies))})
46	    return nodes
47	
48	
49	def definition(workers: list[str], previous: dict | None) -> dict:
50	    """A stored definition over the same nodes is kept verbatim (labels included); anything else is rebuilt."""
51	    nodes = graph_nodes(workers)
52	    stored = (previous or {}).get("definition")
53	    if isinstance(stored, dict) and isinstance(stored.get("nodes"), list) and stored.get("name") and \
54	            [item.get("node_id") for item in stored["nodes"]] == [item["node_id"] for item in nodes]:
55	        return stored
56	    return {"name": "Feature implementation", "nodes": nodes}
57	
58	
59	def utc(timestamp: float) -> str:
60	    return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp, timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
61	
62	
63	def zulu(value: str) -> str:
64	    """Receipts store a +00:00 offset; the export spells UTC with a trailing Z."""
65	    return value.replace("+00:00", "Z")
66	
67	
68	def load_optional(path: Path):
69	    """An absent, non-regular or malformed optional file is None: absent evidence, never invented."""
70	    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
71	        return None
72	    try:
73	        return read_json(path)
74	    except ValueError:
75	        return None
76	
77	
78	def read_events(directory: Path) -> list:
79	    path = directory / "events.jsonl"
80	    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()] if path.exists() else []
81	
82	
83	def string_list(value) -> bool:
84	    return isinstance(value, list) and all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in value)
85	
86	
87	def recorded_transport(directory: Path) -> str | None:
88	    """The transport the run's own reviewer receipts record; None when no reviewer has run."""
89	    if (directory / "review.interactive.json").exists():
90	        return "native"
91	    if (directory / "automatic-review.json").exists():
92	        return "print"
93	    return None
94	
95	
96	def review_section(directory: Path) -> dict | None:
97	    review = load_optional(directory / "review.json")
98	    if review is None:
99	        return None
100	    receipt = load_optional(directory / "automatic-review.json") or {}
101	    transport = recorded_transport(directory) or "manual"
102	    reviewed_at = receipt.get("accepted_at")
103	    if not isinstance(reviewed_at, str):
104	        times = [event["time"] for event in read_events(directory) if event.get("node") == "review"]
105	        reviewed_at = times[-1] if times else utc((directory / "review.json").stat().st_mtime)
106	    diff = None
107	    patch = directory / "review.diff"
108	    if patch.is_file() and not patch.is_symlink():
109	        with patch.open("rb") as handle:
110	            diff = {"path": "review.diff", "sha256": hashlib.file_digest(handle, "sha256").hexdigest(), "bytes": patch.stat().st_size}
111	    findings = [{"severity": finding["severity"], "message": finding["message"], "disposition": finding["disposition"],
112	                 "worker": finding.get("worker"), "requirement": finding.get("requirement")} for finding in review["findings"]]
113	    return {"attempt": 1, "transport": transport, "reviewer_session_id": review["reviewer"], "independent": review["independent"],
114	            "bundle_sha256": review["bundle_sha256"], "candidate_commit": review["candidate_commit"], "verdict": review["verdict"],
115	            "findings": findings, "reviewed_at": reviewed_at, "diff": diff}
116	
117	
118	def launch_receipt(item) -> dict | None:
119	    if (not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("launch_requested_at"), str) or not isinstance(item.get("launch_token"), str)
120	            or not isinstance(item.get("status"), str) or type(item.get("launcher_invocations")) is not int):
121	        return None
122	    optional = {key: item.get(key) if isinstance(item.get(key), str) else None for key in ("session_id", "observed_state", "background_id")}
123	    started = item.get("native_started_at")
124	    return {"session_id": optional["session_id"], "launch_token": item["launch_token"], "launch_requested_at": zulu(item["launch_requested_at"]),
125	            "native_started_at": started if type(started) is int else None, "observed_state": optional["observed_state"],
126	            "status": item["status"], "launcher_invocations": item["launcher_invocations"], "background_id": optional["background_id"]}
127	
128	
129	def completion_signal(item) -> dict | None:
130	    if (not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("status") not in {"completed", "blocked"} or not isinstance(item.get("summary"), str)
131	            or not item["summary"].strip() or not string_list(item.get("open_assumptions"))):
132	        return None
133	    return {"status": item["status"], "summary": item["summary"], "open_assumptions": list(item["open_assumptions"])}
134	
135	
136	def accepted_handoff(item) -> dict | None:
137	    if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("summary"), str) or not item["summary"].strip() or not string_list(item.get("open_assumptions")):
138	        return None
139	    return {"summary": item["summary"], "open_assumptions": list(item["open_assumptions"])}
140	
141	
142	def stop_confirmation(path: Path) -> dict | None:
143	    item = load_optional(path)
144	    if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("stopped"), bool):
145	        return None
146	    return {"stopped": item["stopped"], "confirmed_at": utc(path.stat().st_mtime) if item["stopped"] else None}
147	
148	
149	def worker_inputs(directory: Path, plan: dict, policy: dict, worker: dict) -> dict:
150	    node = worker["node_id"]
151	    prompt = directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt"
152	    return {"role": worker["role"], "required_check_kinds": required_kinds(policy, worker), "task": plan["nodes"][node]["task"],
153	            "prompt": prompt.read_text() if prompt.is_file() and not prompt.is_symlink() else None,
154	            "owned_paths": list(worker["owned_paths"]),
155	            "checks": [{"id": check["id"], "kind": check["kind"], "argv": list(check["argv"]), "command": shlex.join(check["argv"]),
156	                        "timeout_seconds": check["timeout_seconds"],
157	                        "scenarios": [{"id": scenario["id"], "description": scenario["description"]} for scenario in check["scenarios"]]}
158	                       for check in worker["checks"]],
159	            "launch": launch_receipt(load_optional(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")),
160	            "completion": completion_signal(load_optional(directory / f"{node}.completion.json")),
161	            "handoff": accepted_handoff(load_optional(directory / f"{node}.handoff.json")),
162	            "stop": stop_confirmation(directory / f"{node}.stop.json")}
163	
164	
165	def inputs_section(directory: Path, plan: dict, policy: dict) -> dict:
166	    automatic = plan.get("automatic")
167	    workers = plan_workers(plan)
168	    declared = [worker["node_id"] for worker in policy["workers"]]
169	    if not set(workers) <= set(declared):
170	        raise ValueError("Plan selects lanes the pinned policy does not declare")
171	    return {"feature": policy["feature"], "policy_version": policy["version"], "base_commit": plan["base_commit"],
172	            "source_branch": plan.get("source_branch"), "mode": "automatic" if automatic else "manual",
173	            "automatic": None if not automatic else {
174	                "finish": automatic["finish"], "permission_mode": automatic["permission_mode"],
175	                "worker_timeout_seconds": automatic["worker_timeout_seconds"], "review_timeout_seconds": automatic["review_timeout_seconds"],
176	                # Plans pinned before the setting: the transport the receipts record, null before any reviewer ran.
177	                "reviewer_transport": automatic["reviewer_transport"] if "reviewer_transport" in automatic else recorded_transport(directory)},
178	            "setup": [{"argv": list(item["argv"]), "command": shlex.join(item["argv"]), "timeout_seconds": item["timeout_seconds"]}
179	                      for item in policy.get("setup", [])],
180	            "max_verification_attempts": policy.get("max_verification_attempts", 3),
181	            # A drill naming an excluded lane is pinned as null at prepare; plans before the selection keep the policy's.
182	            "failure_drill": plan["failure_drill"] if "failure_drill" in plan else policy.get("failure_drill"),
183	            "selected_workers": list(workers), "excluded_workers": plan_excluded(plan),
184	            "workers": {worker["node_id"]: worker_inputs(directory, plan, policy, worker) for worker in policy["workers"] if worker["node_id"] in workers}}
185	
186	
187	def export_state(runtime, state) -> dict:
188	    """Needs only runtime.directory and runtime.plan; policy comes from runtime.policy or policy.json when present."""
189	    path = runtime.directory / "run-state.json"
190	    previous = read_json(path) if path.exists() else None
191	    events = read_events(runtime.directory)
192	    tasks = [{"node_id": task.name, "error": str(task.error) if task.error else None,
193	              "interrupts": [item.value for item in task.interrupts],
194	              "result": getattr(task, "result", None)} for task in state.tasks]
195	    created = runtime.plan.get("created_at") or utc((runtime.directory / "plan.json").stat().st_mtime)
196	    packets = []
197	    for packet_path in sorted((runtime.directory / "verification").glob("*/*/*/packet.json")):
198	        relative = packet_path.relative_to(runtime.directory)
199	        _, phase, node, attempt, _ = relative.parts
200	        packets.append({"phase": phase, "node_id": node, "attempt": int(attempt), "path": str(relative),
201	                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(packet_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
202	    policy = getattr(runtime, "policy", None) or load_optional(runtime.directory / "policy.json")
203	    value = {"version": EXPORT_VERSION, "run_id": runtime.plan["run_id"], "base_commit": runtime.plan["base_commit"],
204	             "created_at": created, "definition": definition(plan_workers(runtime.plan), previous),
205	             "values": dict(state.values), "next": list(state.next), "tasks": tasks, "events": events,
206	             "verification_packets": packets,
207	             "review": review_section(runtime.directory),
208	             "inputs": inputs_section(runtime.directory, runtime.plan, policy) if policy else None}
209	    if previous and {key: item for key, item in previous.items() if key != "updated_at"} == value:
210	        return previous
211	    value["updated_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
212	    save_json(path, value)
213	    return value

1	"""Complete operator-driven graph: launch → freeze → verify → review → approve → integrate.
2	
3	No agent starts without `start --live`. Operator controls are local CLI-only.
4	
5	The worker lanes come from the run's plan (`plan.workers`, pinned at prepare from the policy
6	and an optional `--workers` selection): one `launch_<lane>` and one `verify_<lane>` node per
7	selected lane around the fixed tail. Excluded lanes keep their owned paths off-limits.
8	"""
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import argparse
12	import hashlib
13	import html
14	import json
15	import os
16	import re
17	import shutil
18	import subprocess
19	import threading
20	from pathlib import Path
21	from typing import Annotated, TypedDict
22	
23	from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver
24	from langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph
25	from langgraph.types import Command, interrupt

28	from .export_state import export_state
29	from .interactive import REVIEW, InteractiveSessions, attach_panels, attach_reviewer_panel
30	from .sessions import git, plan_excluded, plan_workers, prepare, read_json, run_lock, save_json, validate_node_id
31	from .verification import owns, policy_digest, safe_path, validate_policy
32	
33	REVIEW_KEYS = frozenset({"run_id", "bundle_sha256", "candidate_commit", "reviewer", "independent", "verdict", "findings"})
34	FINDING_KEYS = frozenset({"severity", "message", "disposition"})
35	FINDING_LINK_KEYS = frozenset({"worker", "requirement"})
36	# A finding names one lane of the run, several (`multiple`) or none. `both` is the legacy spelling of
37	# `multiple` from two-lane runs; only reviews recorded before configured lanes may still carry it.
38	FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS = frozenset({"multiple", "none"})
39	LEGACY_FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS = FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS | {"both"}
40	
41	
42	def validate_pipeline_policy(policy: dict) -> dict:
43	    """The policy's own rules (schema, ownership, required check kinds) plus the lane-id rules the graph needs."""
44	    validate_policy(policy)
45	    for worker in policy["workers"]:
46	        validate_node_id(worker["node_id"])
47	    return policy
48	
49	
50	def policy_workers(policy: dict) -> list[str]:
51	    return [worker["node_id"] for worker in policy["workers"]]
52	
53	
54	def parse_lane_selection(value: str | None, declared: list[str]) -> list[str]:
55	    """`--workers a,b`: a non-empty subset of the declared lanes, without duplicates, in declared order."""
56	    if value is None:
57	        return list(declared)
58	    selected = [item.strip() for item in value.split(",")]
59	    if not selected or any(not item for item in selected):
60	        raise ValueError("--workers needs a comma-separated list of lane ids")
61	    if len(set(selected)) != len(selected):
62	        raise ValueError(f"--workers lists a lane twice: {value}")
63	    unknown = [item for item in selected if item not in declared]
64	    if unknown:
65	        raise ValueError(f"--workers names lanes the policy does not declare: {', '.join(unknown)} (declared: {', '.join(declared)})")
66	    return [node for node in declared if node in selected]
67	
68	
69	def parse_lane_files(values: list[str] | None, flag: str) -> dict[str, Path]:
70	    """`--task id=path` / `--handoff id=path`, once per lane."""
71	    result = {}
72	    for item in values or []:
73	        node, separator, path = item.partition("=")
74	        if not separator or not node or not path:
75	            raise ValueError(f"{flag} expects <lane>=<path>, got {item!r}")
76	        validate_node_id(node)
77	        if node in result:
78	            raise ValueError(f"{flag} given twice for lane {node}")
79	        result[node] = Path(path)
80	    return result
81	
82	
83	def blocking_findings(findings: list) -> list:
84	    """A P0/P1 finding blocks integration unless it is resolved; accepting it is not resolving it."""
85	    return [finding for finding in findings if finding.get("severity") in {"P0", "P1"} and finding.get("disposition") != "resolved"]
86	
87	
88	def check_review(review: dict, bundle: dict, digest: str, *, require_approved: bool = True, allow_legacy: bool = False) -> None:
89	    """Shape and identity of a persisted review against its exact bundle; approval is checked only when required.
90	
91	    `allow_legacy` accepts the two-lane `both` attribution of reviews recorded before configured lanes (export only).
92	    """
93	    if (not isinstance(review, dict) or set(review) != REVIEW_KEYS or review["run_id"] != bundle["run_id"]
94	            or review["bundle_sha256"] != digest or review["candidate_commit"] != bundle["candidate_commit"]):
95	        raise ValueError("Review must reference this exact run, bundle hash and candidate")
96	    worker_ids = {item["session_id"] for item in bundle["snapshots"].values()}
97	    if review["independent"] is not True or not isinstance(review["reviewer"], str) or not review["reviewer"].strip() or review["reviewer"] in worker_ids:
98	        raise ValueError("Independent reviewer identity required")
99	    if review["verdict"] not in {"approved", "blocked"} or not isinstance(review["findings"], list):
100	        raise ValueError("Malformed review verdict or findings")
101	    if require_approved and review["verdict"] != "approved":
102	        raise ValueError("Review is not approved")
103	    # The bundle's snapshots are exactly the run's selected lanes.
104	    workers = set(bundle["snapshots"]) | (LEGACY_FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS if allow_legacy else FINDING_ATTRIBUTIONS)
105	    for finding in review["findings"]:
106	        if (not isinstance(finding, dict) or not FINDING_KEYS <= set(finding) <= FINDING_KEYS | FINDING_LINK_KEYS
107	                or finding["severity"] not in {"P0", "P1", "P2"} or finding["disposition"] not in {"open", "resolved", "accepted"}
108	                or not isinstance(finding["message"], str) or not finding["message"].strip()):
109	            raise ValueError("Malformed review finding")
110	        if "worker" in finding and finding["worker"] not in workers:
111	            raise ValueError(f"Malformed review finding worker: expected one of {', '.join(sorted(workers))}, got {finding['worker']!r}")
112	        requirement = finding.get("requirement")
113	        if requirement is not None and (not isinstance(requirement, str) or not requirement.strip()):
114	            raise ValueError("Malformed review finding requirement")

161	def lane_positions(workers: list[str]) -> tuple[dict, list, int, int]:
162	    """Report layout: one row per lane for the fan-outs, the fixed tail centred on them."""
163	    rows = [70 + 140 * index for index in range(len(workers))]
164	    centre = (rows[0] + rows[-1]) // 2
165	    positions = {}
166	    for node, y in zip(workers, rows):
167	        positions[f"launch_{node}"] = (90, y)
168	    positions["handoff"] = (280, centre)
169	    for node, y in zip(workers, rows):
170	        positions[f"verify_{node}"] = (470, y)
171	    positions.update(candidate=(660, centre), review=(850, centre), approval=(1040, centre), integrate=(1230, centre))
172	    edges = [(f"launch_{node}", "handoff") for node in workers] + [("handoff", f"verify_{node}") for node in workers] \
173	        + [(f"verify_{node}", "candidate") for node in workers] + [("candidate", "review"), ("review", "approval"), ("approval", "integrate")]
174	    return positions, edges, 1330, rows[-1] + 70

178	    def __init__(self, directory: Path, sessions=None):
179	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
180	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
181	        if "automatic" in self.plan:
182	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
183	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
184	        self.policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(self.directory / "policy.json"))
185	        if self.plan.get("policy_sha256") != policy_digest(self.policy):
186	            raise ValueError("Pinned policy changed")
187	        self.workers, self.excluded = lanes_of(self.plan, self.policy)

191	    def worker_policy(self, node: str) -> dict:
192	        return next(item for item in self.policy["workers"] if item["node_id"] == node)

194	    def failure_drill(self) -> dict | None:
195	        """The pinned drill: null when prepare skipped it for an excluded lane; the policy's for plans pinned before."""
196	        return self.plan["failure_drill"] if "failure_drill" in self.plan else self.policy.get("failure_drill")

198	    def event(self, node: str, status: str, message: str):
199	        with self._events_lock:
200	            path = self.directory / "events.jsonl"
201	            prior = path.read_text().splitlines() if path.exists() else []
202	            sequence = json.loads(prior[-1])["sequence"] + 1 if prior else 1
203	            record = {"sequence": sequence, "time": now(), "node": node, "status": status, "message": message}
204	            with path.open("a") as handle:
205	                handle.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
206	                handle.flush()
207	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())

209	    def launch(self, node: str) -> dict:
210	        self.event(node, "running", "Launching or reconciling the exact native session")
211	        try:
212	            receipt = self.sessions.run(node)
213	        except Exception as error:
214	            self.event(node, "blocked", str(error))
215	            raise
216	        self.event(node, "interactive", "Awaiting explicit completion signal; idle is not acceptance")

219	    def launch_reviewer(self, prompt: str, launch_token: str, candidate_commit: str) -> dict:
220	        self.event(REVIEW, "running", "Launching the native reviewer session")
221	        try:
222	            receipt = self.sessions.run_reviewer(prompt, launch_token, candidate_commit)
223	        except Exception as error:
224	            self.event(REVIEW, "blocked", str(error))
225	            raise

227	        if (self.directory / "terminals.json").exists() and os.environ.get("HERDR_ENV") == "1":
228	            # The pane is a convenience for the operator; its absence never fails the review. The
229	            # session is launched by now, so a Ctrl-C here is recorded, then propagated as an
230	            # interruption (the review node keeps the running session), never as a launch failure.
231	            try:

241	        """Bind the session an interrupted reviewer launch produced; nothing is launched."""
242	        path = self.directory / "review.interactive.json"
243	        if not path.exists():
244	            raise RuntimeError("No durable reviewer launch intent; cannot reconcile without potentially launching a new reviewer")
245	        self.event(REVIEW, "running", "Reconciling the interrupted reviewer launch; nothing is relaunched")
246	        try:

254	    def stop_session(self, node: str) -> None:
255	        """Persist native identity before stopping. Never signal guessed/reused PIDs."""
256	        marker = self.directory / f"{node}.stop.json"
257	        if marker.exists():
258	            intent = read_json(marker)
259	        else:
260	            row = self.sessions.locate(node, self.sessions.inventory())
261	            if row is None:
262	                raise RuntimeError(f"{node} session missing before stop; reconcile before continuing")
263	            intent = {"background_id": row["id"], "session_id": row["sessionId"], "pid": row["pid"], "stopped": False}
264	            save_json(marker, intent)
265	        if not intent["stopped"]:
266	            rows = self.sessions.inventory()
267	            matching = [row for row in rows if row.get("sessionId") == intent["session_id"] and row.get("pid")]
268	            if matching:
269	                row = self.sessions.locate(node, rows)
270	                if row is None or row["id"] != intent["background_id"] or row["pid"] != intent["pid"]:
271	                    raise RuntimeError(f"Native {node} session identity changed after stop intent; reconcile manually")
272	                result = subprocess.run([self.sessions.executable, "stop", intent["background_id"]], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
273	                if result.returncode != 0:
274	                    raise RuntimeError(f"Stop failed for {node}; inspect native session before retrying")
275	            # Recover stop-before-receipt without issuing another stop command.
276	            rows = self.sessions.inventory()
277	            if any(row.get("sessionId") == intent["session_id"] and row.get("pid") for row in rows) or pid_alive(intent["pid"]):
278	                raise RuntimeError(f"{node} termination is not established; retry after reconciliation")
279	            intent["stopped"] = True
280	            save_json(marker, intent)

282	    def stop_workers(self):
283	        for node in self.workers:
284	            self.stop_session(node)
285	        stopped_ids = {read_json(self.directory / f"{node}.stop.json")["session_id"] for node in self.workers}
286	        if any(row.get("sessionId") in stopped_ids and row.get("pid") for row in self.sessions.inventory()):
287	            raise RuntimeError("A stopped worker was restarted; reconcile before snapshot capture")
288	        self.event("freeze", "stopped", f"Native workers stopped before snapshot capture: {', '.join(self.workers)}")

290	    def stop_reviewer(self):
291	        self.stop_session(REVIEW)
292	        self.event(REVIEW, "stopped", "Reviewer session stopped; its transcript stays resumable")

294	    def freeze(self) -> dict:
295	        record = self.directory / "snapshots.json"
296	        if record.exists():
297	            return read_json(record)
298	        handoffs = {}
299	        for node in self.workers:
300	            handoff_path = self.directory / f"{node}.handoff.json"
301	            if not handoff_path.exists():
302	                raise ValueError(f"Missing {node} handoff: summary and open_assumptions are required")
303	            handoff = read_json(handoff_path)
304	            if set(handoff) != {"summary", "open_assumptions"} or not isinstance(handoff["summary"], str) or not handoff["summary"].strip() or not isinstance(handoff["open_assumptions"], list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in handoff["open_assumptions"]):
305	                raise ValueError("Malformed worker handoff")
306	            handoffs[node] = handoff
307	        self.stop_workers()
308	        # Ownership is enforced from the full declared policy: an excluded lane's paths are off-limits to every selected lane.
309	        excluded_paths = [(other, safe_path(prefix)) for other in self.excluded for prefix in self.worker_policy(other)["owned_paths"]]
310	        snapshots = {}
311	        for node in self.workers:
312	            worker = self.worker_policy(node)
313	            cwd = Path(self.plan["nodes"][node]["worktree"])
314	            if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"]:
315	                raise ValueError("Worker changed HEAD; reconcile commits rather than silently accepting them")
316	            changed = changed_files(cwd, self.plan["base_commit"])
317	            for name in changed:
318	                safe_path(name)
319	                for other, prefix in excluded_paths:
320	                    if owns(name, prefix):
321	                        raise ValueError(f"Ownership violation: {node} edited {name}, owned by excluded lane {other}")
322	                if not any(owns(name, safe_path(prefix)) for prefix in worker["owned_paths"]):
323	                    raise ValueError(f"{node} edited unowned path: {name}")
324	                if (cwd / name).is_symlink():
325	                    raise ValueError("Symlink changes require manual review before snapshot")
326	            index = self.directory / f"{node}.snapshot-index"
327	            if index.exists():
328	                index.unlink()  # Only our private temporary index, never a user's index.
329	            env = commit_env()
330	            env["GIT_INDEX_FILE"] = str(index)
331	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "read-tree", self.plan["base_commit"]], env=env, check=True)
332	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "add", "-A", "--", "."], env=env, check=True)
333	            tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "write-tree"], env=env, text=True).strip()
334	            # Validate paths from the actual captured tree, including staged renames/deletes.
335	            captured = git(cwd, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-r", self.plan["base_commit"], tree).splitlines()
336	            if sorted(captured) != changed:
337	                raise ValueError("Files changed during snapshot; refuse inconsistent evidence")
338	            commit = self.plan["base_commit"]
339	            if changed:
340	                commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "commit-tree", tree,
341	                                                  "-p", self.plan["base_commit"], "-m", f"Workflow {self.plan['run_id']}: {node}"], env=env, text=True).strip()
342	            ref = f"refs/workflow/{hashlib.sha256(str(self.directory).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]}/{node}"
343	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "update-ref", ref, commit], check=True)
344	            receipt = read_json(self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
345	            snapshots[node] = {"commit": commit, "changed_files": changed, "session_id": receipt["session_id"], **handoffs[node]}
346	        save_json(record, snapshots)
347	        self.event("freeze", "succeeded", "Immutable snapshots captured; worker-reported checks are not trusted")
348	        return snapshots

372	    def verify(self, node: str, snapshots: dict) -> str:
373	        snap = snapshots[node]
374	        attempt = self.attempt("worker", node)
375	        self.event(f"verify_{node}", "running", f"Attempt {attempt}; revision {snap['commit']}")
376	        packet = verify_revision(self.directory, self.plan, self.policy, node, snap["commit"], snap["changed_files"], snap["session_id"], attempt=attempt)
377	        path = self.directory / "verification" / "worker" / node / str(attempt) / "packet.json"
378	        drill = self.failure_drill()
379	        if drill and drill["node_id"] == node and attempt == 1:
380	            marker = "Intentional lab drill: verification branch failure, not a worker or test failure"
381	            if marker not in packet["capture_errors"]:
382	                packet["capture_errors"].append(marker)
383	                packet["gate"]["reasons"].append(marker)
384	            packet["gate"]["status"] = "blocked"
385	            drill_path = self.directory / "failure-drill.json"
386	            if not drill_path.exists():
387	                save_json(drill_path, {"node_id": node, "phase": "worker", "attempt": 1,
388	                                       "injected_at": now(), "native_before": self.native_evidence()})
389	        packet["result"]["summary"] = snap["summary"]
390	        packet["result"]["open_assumptions"] = snap["open_assumptions"]
391	        save_json(path, packet)
392	        passed = "Required tests and artifacts passed"
393	        if packet["gate"].get("deferred_checks"):
394	            passed += "; recorded for the candidate gate: " + ", ".join(packet["gate"]["deferred_checks"])
395	        self.event(f"verify_{node}", packet["gate"]["status"], "; ".join(packet["gate"]["reasons"]) or passed)
396	        if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
397	            raise RuntimeError(f"{node} verification blocked; see {path}. Retry explicitly or start a revised run.")
398	        return str(path)

400	    def candidate(self, state: PipelineState) -> str:
401	        # Validate branch evidence again before combining anything.
402	        worker_paths = [Path(state["packets"][node]) for node in self.workers]
403	        for path in worker_paths:
404	            packet = recheck_packet(read_json(path), self.policy, self.directory)
405	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
406	                raise ValueError("Worker evidence no longer passes")
407	        saved = self.directory / "candidate.json"
408	        if saved.exists():
409	            candidate = read_json(saved)
410	        else:
411	            cwd = self.directory / "candidate"
412	            if cwd.exists():
413	                raise ValueError("Partial candidate worktree exists; inspect before recovery")
414	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", self.plan["repository"], "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(cwd), self.plan["base_commit"]], check=True, capture_output=True)
415	            for node in self.workers:  # Declared order, selected lanes only.
416	                commit = state["snapshots"][node]["commit"]
417	                if commit != self.plan["base_commit"]:
418	                    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "cherry-pick", commit], env=commit_env(), check=True, capture_output=True)
419	            candidate = {"commit": git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), "worktree": str(cwd)}
420	            save_json(saved, candidate)
421	        candidate_paths = []
422	        for node in self.workers:
423	            attempt = self.attempt("candidate", node)
424	            packet = verify_revision(self.directory, self.plan, self.policy, node, candidate["commit"],
425	                                     changed_files(Path(candidate["worktree"]), self.plan["base_commit"]),
426	                                     state["snapshots"][node]["session_id"], phase="candidate", attempt=attempt)
427	            path = self.directory / "verification" / "candidate" / node / str(attempt) / "packet.json"
428	            self.event(f"candidate_{node}", packet["gate"]["status"], f"Combined revision {candidate['commit']}")
429	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
430	                raise RuntimeError(f"Combined candidate failed {node} checks; see {path}")
431	            candidate_paths.append(path)
432	        bundle = {"run_id": self.plan["run_id"], "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"],
433	                  "candidate_commit": candidate["commit"], "policy_sha256": policy_digest(self.policy),
434	                  "snapshots": state["snapshots"],
435	                  "packets": [{"path": str(path), "sha256": digest_file(path)} for path in worker_paths + candidate_paths]}
436	        path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
437	        drill_path = self.directory / "failure-drill.json"
438	        if drill_path.exists():
439	            before = read_json(drill_path)["native_before"]
440	            after = self.native_evidence()
441	            audit = {"run_id": self.plan["run_id"], "native_before": before, "native_after": after,
442	                     "workers_with_changed_launch_evidence": [node for node in self.workers if before.get(node) != after.get(node)],
443	                     "verification_attempts": {node: sorted(int(item.name) for item in (self.directory / "verification" / "worker" / node).iterdir() if item.is_dir() and item.name.isdigit()) for node in self.workers},
444	                     "scope": "Pipeline-issued sessions; native launch times/counts are null when unavailable. Out-of-band manual restarts are not certified."}
445	            save_json(self.directory / "failure-report.json", audit)
446	            bundle["failure_drill"] = audit
447	        save_json(path, bundle)
448	        return str(path)

450	    def validate_bundle(self) -> tuple[dict, str]:
451	        path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
452	        bundle = read_json(path)
453	        if bundle["run_id"] != self.plan["run_id"] or bundle["policy_sha256"] != policy_digest(self.policy):
454	            raise ValueError("Bundle identity/policy changed")
455	        for reference in bundle["packets"]:
456	            packet_path = Path(reference["path"]).resolve()
457	            if not packet_path.is_relative_to(self.directory) or digest_file(packet_path) != reference["sha256"]:
458	                raise ValueError("Review evidence changed")
459	            packet = recheck_packet(read_json(packet_path), self.policy, self.directory)
460	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
461	                raise ValueError("Review artifact missing, changed or failing")
462	        return bundle, digest_file(path)

464	    def validate_review(self, review: dict, require_approved: bool = True) -> None:

468	    def integrate(self, approved: str) -> str:
469	        bundle, digest = self.validate_bundle()
470	        review = read_json(self.directory / "review.json")
471	        self.validate_review(review)
472	        if approved != digest:
473	            raise ValueError("Approval references stale evidence")
474	        repo = Path(self.plan["repository"])
475	        candidate = bundle["candidate_commit"]
476	        intent = self.directory / "integration-intent.json"
477	        if git(repo, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") != self.plan["source_branch"]:
478	            raise ValueError("Source branch changed")
479	        if git(repo, "status", "--porcelain"):
480	            raise ValueError("Source worktree is dirty; refusing integration")
481	        if intent.exists():
482	            if read_json(intent) != {"bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": candidate}:
483	                raise ValueError("Integration intent changed")
484	            if git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == candidate:
485	                return candidate
486	        if git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"]:
487	            raise ValueError("Source advanced since preparation; rebase/review explicitly")
488	        save_json(intent, {"bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": candidate})
489	        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "merge", "--ff-only", candidate], check=True, capture_output=True)
490	        self.event("integrate", "succeeded", f"Fast-forwarded to {candidate}; no push performed")
491	        return candidate

494	class ExportRuntime:
495	    """Read-only view of a run directory for re-exporting run-state.json.
496	
497	    It constructs no sessions and touches no worktree, so a copied or finished
498	    run whose worktrees are gone still exports. Contradictory files are refused.
499	    """
500	
501	    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
502	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
503	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
504	        if "automatic" in self.plan:
505	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
506	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
507	        self.policy = None
508	        policy_path = self.directory / "policy.json"
509	        if policy_path.exists():
510	            self.policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
511	            if self.plan.get("policy_sha256") != policy_digest(self.policy):
512	                raise ValueError("Pinned policy changed")
513	        self.workers, self.excluded = lanes_of(self.plan, self.policy)
514	        review_path = self.directory / "review.json"
515	        if review_path.exists():
516	            bundle_path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
517	            if not bundle_path.exists():
518	                raise ValueError("review.json exists without review-bundle.json; contradictory run directory")
519	            # Packet hashes are not rechecked here; the adapter re-verifies packets itself. Reviews recorded
520	            # before configured lanes may attribute a finding to `both`; the viewer renders it as several lanes.
521	            check_review(read_json(review_path), read_json(bundle_path), digest_file(bundle_path), require_approved=False,
522	                         allow_legacy="workers" not in self.plan)
523

525	def lanes_of(plan: dict, policy: dict | None) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
526	    """The run's selected and excluded lanes, checked against the pinned policy when it is present."""
527	    workers, excluded = plan_workers(plan), plan_excluded(plan)
528	    if policy is not None:
529	        declared = policy_workers(policy)
530	        if not set(workers) <= set(declared) or not set(excluded) <= set(declared):
531	            raise ValueError("Plan names lanes the pinned policy does not declare")
532	        if "workers" in plan and set(workers) | set(excluded) != set(declared):
533	            raise ValueError("Plan does not account for every declared lane")
534	    if set(plan.get("nodes", {})) != set(workers):
535	        raise ValueError("Plan nodes do not match the selected lanes; inspect retained allocation state")
536	    return workers, excluded

539	def carry_legacy_lanes(runtime: ExportRuntime, state, saver: SqliteSaver | None = None):
540	    """Carry a pre-lane checkpoint's per-lane evidence into the lane state shape.
541	
542	    A checkpoint written before configured lanes stored each lane under `<lane>` and
543	    `<lane>_packet`; the graph no longer has those channels, so `get_state` drops them.
544	    Read them from the raw checkpoint and carry them under `lanes`/`packets` so the launch
545	    evidence survives every export, whether from `export` or from the report written at
546	    each CLI boundary. Runs with configured lanes are returned unchanged.
547	    """
548	    from types import SimpleNamespace
549	    database = runtime.directory / "pipeline.sqlite"
550	    if "workers" in runtime.plan or not database.exists():
551	        return state
552	    config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}}
553	
554	    def carry(saver: SqliteSaver):
555	        stored = saver.get_tuple(config)
556	        raw = stored.checkpoint.get("channel_values", {}) if stored else {}
557	        values = dict(state.values)
558	        for node in runtime.workers:
559	            if node in raw:
560	                values.setdefault("lanes", {}).setdefault(node, raw[node])
561	            if f"{node}_packet" in raw:
562	                values.setdefault("packets", {}).setdefault(node, raw[f"{node}_packet"])
563	        return SimpleNamespace(values=values, next=state.next, tasks=state.tasks)
564	
565	    if saver is not None:
566	        return carry(saver)
567	    with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(database)) as own:
568	        return carry(own)

571	def export_run(runtime: ExportRuntime) -> dict:
572	    """Re-export from the persisted checkpoint. Reading state never invokes a node or a session."""
573	    from types import SimpleNamespace
574	    database = runtime.directory / "pipeline.sqlite"
575	    if database.exists():
576	        config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}}
577	        with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(database)) as saver:
578	            state = carry_legacy_lanes(runtime, build_pipeline(saver, runtime).get_state(config), saver)
579	    else:
580	        state = SimpleNamespace(values={}, next=tuple(f"launch_{node}" for node in runtime.workers), tasks=[])  # Prepared, never started.
581	    return export_state(runtime, state)

584	def build_pipeline(checkpointer, runtime):
585	    """The graph over the runtime's plan: `launch_<lane>` and `verify_<lane>` per selected lane, then the fixed tail."""
586	    workers = list(runtime.workers)
587	    def launcher(node):
588	        return lambda _state: {"lanes": {node: runtime.launch(node)}}
589	    def verifier(node):
590	        return lambda state: {"packets": {node: runtime.verify(node, state["snapshots"])}}
591	    def handoff(_state):
592	        message = ("Awaiting explicit completion signals and automatic freeze." if runtime.plan.get("automatic")
593	                   else f"Type in Claude terminals; provide a handoff for every lane ({', '.join(workers)}), then explicitly freeze.")
594	        decision = interrupt({"kind": "worker_handoff", "message": message})
595	        if decision != {"freeze": True}:
596	            raise ValueError("Explicit freeze required")
597	        return {"snapshots": runtime.freeze()}
598	    def candidate(state): return {"bundle": runtime.candidate(state)}
599	    def review(_state):
600	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
601	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
602	            from .automatic import review_candidate
603	            decision = review_candidate(runtime)
604	        else:
605	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "independent_review", "bundle_sha256": digest,
606	                                  "bundle_path": str(runtime.directory / "review-bundle.json")})
607	        runtime.validate_review(decision)
608	        save_json(runtime.directory / "review.json", decision)
609	        runtime.event("review", "approved", decision["reviewer"])
610	        return {"review": decision}
611	    def approval(_state):
612	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
613	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
614	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
615	            validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
616	            decision = {"approve": digest}  # Explicit run-level authority: feature branch only.
617	        else:
618	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "integration_approval", "bundle_sha256": digest,
619	                                  "message": "Approve fast-forward of source branch; no push."})
620	        if decision != {"approve": digest}:
621	            raise ValueError("Explicit exact-bundle approval required")
622	        return {"approved_bundle": digest}
623	    def integrate(state): return {"integrated_commit": runtime.integrate(state["approved_bundle"])}
624	    graph = StateGraph(PipelineState)
625	    launches = [f"launch_{node}" for node in workers]
626	    verifies = [f"verify_{node}" for node in workers]
627	    for node, name in zip(workers, launches):
628	        graph.add_node(name, launcher(node))
629	    for node, name in zip(workers, verifies):
630	        graph.add_node(name, verifier(node))
631	    for name, function in (("handoff", handoff), ("candidate", candidate), ("review", review), ("approval", approval), ("integrate", integrate)):
632	        graph.add_node(name, function)
633	    for name in launches:
634	        graph.add_edge(START, name)
635	    graph.add_edge(launches, "handoff")
636	    for name in verifies:
637	        graph.add_edge("handoff", name)
638	    graph.add_edge(verifies, "candidate")
639	    graph.add_edge("candidate", "review"); graph.add_edge("review", "approval")
640	    graph.add_edge("approval", "integrate"); graph.add_edge("integrate", END)
641	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

649	def report(runtime: Pipeline, state) -> Path:
650	    """Escaped local results viewer, generated on every CLI boundary; no server needed."""
651	    state = carry_legacy_lanes(runtime, state)  # `status` on a legacy run must export the same evidence as `export`.
652	    export_state(runtime, state)
653	    events_path = runtime.directory / "events.jsonl"
654	    events = [json.loads(line) for line in events_path.read_text().splitlines()] if events_path.exists() else []
655	    packets = list((runtime.directory / "verification").glob("*/*/*/packet.json"))
656	    flow = ("Launch workers → completion signals → isolated checks → combined checks → independent review → verified feature branch (no main merge or push)"
657	            if runtime.plan.get("automatic") else "Launch workers → human handoff → isolated checks → combined checks → independent review → approval → integration")
658	    parts = ['<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Workflow report</title><style>body{font:16px system-ui;max-width:1100px;margin:40px auto;background:#151820;color:#eee}pre{white-space:pre-wrap}a{color:#8dcaff}img{max-width:100%}section{border:1px solid #555;padding:16px;margin:16px 0}</style>',
659	             '<h1>Workflow report</h1><p>' + html.escape(flow) + '</p>',
660	             '<h2>Current state</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps({"next": state.next, "interrupts": [str(task.interrupts) for task in state.tasks if task.interrupts], "errors": [str(task.error) for task in state.tasks if task.error], "integrated_commit": state.values.get("integrated_commit")}, indent=2)) + '</pre>',
661	             '<h2>Timeline</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps(events, indent=2)) + '</pre>']
662	    positions, edges, width, height = lane_positions(list(runtime.workers))
663	    svg = [f'<h2>Execution graph</h2><svg role="img" aria-label="Workflow execution graph" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}">']
664	    for left, right in edges:
665	        x1, y1 = positions[left]; x2, y2 = positions[right]
666	        svg.append(f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="#9aa"/>')
667	    for name, (x, y) in positions.items():
668	        color = '#665000' if name in state.next else '#263747'
669	        svg.append(f'<rect x="{x-75}" y="{y-23}" width="150" height="46" rx="8" fill="{color}" stroke="#9aa"/><text x="{x}" y="{y+5}" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="14">{html.escape(name)}</text>')
670	    lanes = ", ".join(runtime.workers) + (f" (excluded: {', '.join(runtime.excluded)})" if runtime.excluded else "")
671	    svg.append(f'</svg><p>Lanes: {html.escape(lanes)}. Highlighted nodes are pending. A completed launch is not a completed worker task.</p>')
672	    parts[2:2] = svg
673	    from urllib.parse import quote
674	    for path in packets:
675	        packet = read_json(path)
676	        parts.append('<section><h2>' + html.escape(str(path.relative_to(runtime.directory))) + '</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps({"gate": packet["gate"], "result": packet["result"]}, indent=2)) + '</pre>')
677	        for artifact in packet["result"]["artifacts"]:
678	            local = Path(packet["artifact_paths"][artifact["artifact_id"]]).resolve()
679	            if not local.is_relative_to(runtime.directory):
680	                continue
681	            url = quote(str(local.relative_to(runtime.directory)), safe="/")
682	            parts.append(f'<p><a href="{url}">{html.escape(artifact["artifact_id"])}</a></p>')
683	            if artifact["kind"] == "screenshot":
684	                parts.append(f'<img alt="Browser scenario screenshot" src="{url}">')
685	        parts.append('</section>')
686	    failure_report = runtime.directory / "failure-report.json"
687	    if failure_report.exists():
688	        parts.append('<h2>Checkpoint failure drill</h2><pre>' + html.escape(failure_report.read_text()) + '</pre>')
689	    destination = runtime.directory / "report.html"
690	    destination.write_text("\n".join(parts))
691	    return destination

695	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
696	    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["preflight", "prepare", "start", "automatic", "automatic-step", "attach", "freeze", "retry", "reconcile", "review", "approve", "status", "export"])
697	    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)

701	    parser.add_argument("--task", action="append", metavar="LANE=PATH", help="prepare: task file for one selected lane; repeat once per lane")
702	    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true")
703	    parser.add_argument("--automatic", action="store_true", help="Prepare run-scoped permission bypass and automatic feature-branch completion")
704	    parser.add_argument("--worker-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: deadline per worker from launch until its completion signal (default 4h)")
705	    parser.add_argument("--review-timeout-seconds", type=int, help="Automatic mode: reviewer deadline from its launch to its completion file (default 30m)")

707	    parser.add_argument("--herdr", action="store_true")
708	    parser.add_argument("--handoff", action="append", metavar="LANE=PATH", help="freeze: handoff file for one selected lane; repeat once per lane")
709	    parser.add_argument("--review-file", type=Path)
710	    parser.add_argument("--bundle-sha256")
711	    parser.add_argument("--node", help="retry: the lane whose failed check reruns (validated against the run's lanes)")
712	    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["worker", "candidate"], default="worker")
713	    args = parser.parse_args()
714	    directory = args.directory.resolve()
715	    try:
716	        if args.action == "preflight":
717	            if not args.policy:
718	                parser.error("preflight requires --policy")
719	            policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(args.policy))
720	            if git(args.repo.resolve(), "status", "--porcelain"):
721	                raise ValueError("Source must be clean before prepare")
722	            for executable in ("git", "claude", "node"):

724	                    raise ValueError(f"Missing executable: {executable}")
725	            help_text = subprocess.check_output(["claude", "--help"], text=True, timeout=15)
726	            required_flags = ["--bg", "--safe-mode", "--tools", "--permission-mode"]
727	            if args.automatic:

729	                # Print-mode reviewer (--reviewer-transport print): --json-schema, --print, --permission-prompts.
730	                required_flags += ["--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--add-dir", "--allowedTools", "--json-schema", "--print", "--permission-prompts"]
731	            if not all(flag in help_text for flag in required_flags):
732	                raise ValueError("Installed Claude CLI lacks required flags")
733	            auth = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["claude", "auth", "status"], text=True, timeout=15))
734	            if auth.get("loggedIn") is not True:

737	                raise ValueError("Herdr attachment requires a managed caller pane")
738	            print(json.dumps({"preflight": "passed", "base_commit": git(args.repo.resolve(), "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
739	                              "policy_sha256": policy_digest(policy), "note": "No agents launched. Actual dependency/test availability is checked in isolated verification worktrees."}, indent=2))
740	            return

742	            if not args.policy or not args.task:

744	            policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(args.policy))

757	            plan = prepare(directory, args.repo, "HEAD", tasks, True, declared=declared)

762	            if args.automatic:

779	                parser.error("automatic requires --live because it can launch an independent reviewer")
780	            from .automatic import supervise
781	            supervise(directory)
782	            print(f"Automatic run reached a verified feature branch. Evidence: {directory / 'report.html'}. No main merge or push.")
783	            return
784	        if args.action == "export":
785	            # Re-export an existing run (for example one recorded before a newer export version).
786	            with run_lock(directory):
787	                exported = export_run(ExportRuntime(directory))
788	            print(f"Exported run-state.json version {exported['version']}: {directory / 'run-state.json'}. No agents launched.")
789	            return
790	        with run_lock(directory):
791	            runtime = Pipeline(directory)
792	            if args.action == "automatic-step":
793	                if not args.live:
794	                    parser.error("automatic requires --live because it can launch an independent reviewer")
795	                from .automatic import drive
796	                commit = drive(runtime, single_step=True)
797	                if commit is None:
798	                    parser.exit(75, "Checkpoint persisted; continuing in a new controller process.\n")
799	                print(f"Verified feature branch: {runtime.plan['source_branch']} at {commit}. No main merge or push.")
800	                return
801	            if args.action == "attach":
802	                print(json.dumps(attach_panels(runtime.sessions), indent=2)); return
803	            with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(directory / "pipeline.sqlite")) as saver:
804	                graph = build_pipeline(saver, runtime)
805	                config = graph_config(runtime)
806	                state = graph.get_state(config)
807	                pending = [item.value.get("kind") for task in state.tasks for item in task.interrupts]
808	                value = None
809	                if args.action == "start":
810	                    if not args.live:
811	                        parser.error("start requires --live; do not use it for offline tests")
812	                    if state.values:
813	                        parser.error("Run already started; use status/explicit controls, never start again")
814	                    value = {"run_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}
815	                elif args.action == "freeze":
816	                    if pending != ["worker_handoff"]:

821	                    for node, handoff_path in handoffs.items():

823	                    value = Command(resume={"freeze": True})
824	                elif args.action == "review":

826	                        parser.error("Review requires pending review and --review-file")
827	                    decision = read_json(args.review_file)
828	                    runtime.validate_review(decision)
829	                    value = Command(resume=decision)
830	                elif args.action == "approve":
831	                    if pending != ["integration_approval"]:
832	                        parser.error("Run is not waiting for integration approval")
833	                    _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
834	                    if args.bundle_sha256 != digest:
835	                        parser.error("Provide the exact --bundle-sha256 displayed at approval")
836	                    value = Command(resume={"approve": digest})
837	                elif args.action == "reconcile":
838	                    if pending or not state.next or not any(step.startswith("launch_") for step in state.next):
839	                        parser.error("Reconcile requires failed launch steps")
840	                    for step in state.next:

868	                                      "errors": [str(task.error) for task in state.tasks if task.error]}, indent=2))
869	                    print(f"Report: {report(runtime, state)}")

871	        parser.exit(1, f"Blocked: {error}\nAll work/evidence retained at {directory}. No automatic fallback or push.\n")

import json
import subprocess
import sys

import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from .automatic import DEFAULTS, automatic_settings, drive, read_completion, review_candidate, validate_automatic, wait_handoffs, supervise

class CompletionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):

        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
